description: The shape a stock Ubuntu has: a vendor file sets kernel.kptr_restrict = 1, which is the value that looks safe and hands the kernel layout to anything holding CAP_SYSLOG — a container granted it for logging, a monitoring agent. The check fails it at MEDIUM rather than HIGH: this operator did something and not enough, which is a different conversation from one who did nothing. dmesg_restrict is set correctly beside it, so exactly one of the two checks moves.
